description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) scores for four different relation extraction methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of samples generated, which is plotted on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and uses a linear scale ranging from K=8 to K=64, with tick marks at these four discrete values. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and also uses a linear scale, ranging from approximately 24% to 51%, with tick marks at intervals of 5%. The blue line with circle markers represents TACRED, starting at approximately 23% at K=8 and rising to about 30% at K=64. The orange line with triangle markers represents TACRED-Revisit, beginning at about 24% at K=8 and peaking at roughly 31% at K=32 before declining slightly to around 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers represents Re-TACRED, starting at approximately 35% at K=8, increasing to a peak of 51% at K=32, and then decreasing to about 48% at K=64. The red line with star markers represents SemEval, which begins at approximately 43% at K=8 and steadily increases to about 52% at K=64.
